question: What is the meaning of mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product in relation to renewable materials?
data_point: mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product
description:
The mass fraction of renewable materials in or attributed to the product refers to the proportion of the total product mass that is made up of renewable materials. This is expressed as a range defined in the standard. <|ENDINPUT>
